newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's minimum wage to rise to 120 reais - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's minimum wage to rise to 120 reais - paper.

text.p: Brazilian Finance Minister Pedro Malan is likely to announce on Friday a 7.14 percent increase in the minimum wage to 120 reais ($113) per month from 112 reais ($105), Folha de Sao Paulo daily said.

The new minimum wage, which will take effect on May 1, will be below a projected 8.0 percent rise in the Fipe consumer price index between May 1, 1996, date of the last adjustment, and April 30 this year, the newspaper said.
Folha said the government's initial proposal was to raise the minimum wage by 6.5 percent to 119.28 reais.
According to data from Brazil's Labor Ministry, only 4.29 percent of a total of 23.59 million formal workers received up to one minimum wage in 1995, the paper added.
